title: Scentoria — Perfume Discovery & Catalog
description: A luxury perfume discovery platform with a searchable, filterable product catalog, detailed fragrance pages with pricing, a shopping cart, and a wishlist — in a responsive, dark glassmorphism UI.

title: QuantumMark — Digital Watermarking Platform
description: A full-stack image watermarking platform pairing a Flask backend with simulator-based quantum key generation. Embeds and verifies watermarks while reporting PSNR, SSIM, entropy, and resilience against attacks like JPEG compression, noise, rotation, crop, and blur.

title: WeatherNow — Real-Time Weather App
description: A real-time weather app showing current conditions, a 5-day forecast, hourly trends, and air quality index, powered by the OpenWeatherMap API with an offline-aware, glassmorphism interface.
